what: the owner's rulings on the calls the corpus lane put, as the lane wrote them down: the owner's own words, the calls as they were put, and each ruling pinned to the file, the branch or class, and the option it rules. Kept here byte for byte, one folder per relay as the lane keeps them. A tool of this lane that applies a ruling reads it from here (tools/rulings-v1.mjs)
note: every sha256 here is the one the relay's letter names for the file, and the bytes taken hash to it
